title: Working-age (15-64) low back pain cases, indexed to 1990

source.name: Global Burden of Disease-based analysis of working-age low back pain
source.publisher: Peer-reviewed epidemiology research, as compiled in mainstream health coverage

notes: A GBD-based analysis of people aged 15-64 found 452.8 million working-age low back pain cases, a 52.66% increase since 1990. Shown here as an index (1990 = 100) so the percent change is the number on screen; the underlying 1990 case count is not separately reported.
